stemMd: A library’s loan count fell after it introduced longer lending periods. A critic says the service became less useful. Which fact most directly offers an alternative explanation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Readers could keep each book longer, so fewer renewals were counted as new loans.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The library has a front door.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The library owns books of different lengths.

explanationMd: Changing the lending period can change how transactions are counted without reducing reading or usefulness. Fewer renewals may lower the loan metric mechanically. The critic needs evidence about outcomes, not just a count affected by the new rules.

distractorRationale.e: This does not explain the loan-count change.
distractorRationale.d: Book length alone does not connect to the policy-induced count change.
distractorRationale.c: The critic’s reading habits do not explain the metric.
distractorRationale.b: This is irrelevant to the inference.
